title: PocketGull Clinical & Scientific Font Superfamily
subtitle: Optotypically calibrated 1000 UPM vector fonts for EHRs, ICU telemetry & STEM
description: PocketGull is an open-source clinical sans-serif, display, mathematical, and telemetry monospace font superfamily (SIL Open Font License 1.1) engineered on a standardized 1000 UPM em-square. Grounded in Louise Sloan 5:1 optotypic visual acuity standards and Institute for Safe Medication Practices (ISMP) look-alike character disambiguation, it includes 32 TrueType (.ttf) and Brotli-compressed WebFont (.woff2) binaries, 256 ISO/TR 11548 tactile Braille cells, gapless 600 UPM ICU telemetry box-drawing and sub-cell ECG waveforms, OpenType MATH tables, Scotopic 650nm dark-sky red mode, and sovereign multi-script orthographies.

resources.description: PocketGull Regular (Fineliner, wght 400): Proportional clinical sans-serif for EHR charts, patient discharge summaries, and scientific plots.
PocketGull Bold (wght 700): High-acuity display titling, Bionic reading saccade anchors, and clinical trauma alarms.
PocketGull Mono Regular (Fixed 600 UPM pitch): Gapless ICU telemetry box drawing (U+2500-U+257F), 80-column FITS headers, and sub-cell ECG waveforms.
PocketGull Math (68 UPM stem weight): ISO/IEC 14496-22 OpenType MATH font for Matplotlib, LaTeX, and Typst scientific typesetting.
PocketGull Variable Font (wght 100-900): Brotli Q11 compressed webfont with zero-CLS metric overrides.
Cryptographic SHA-256 and Subresource Integrity (SRI SHA-384) manifest for all 32 TrueType and WOFF2 font binaries.
